Under the leadership of Executive Chef and Partner Michael Anthony alongside Chef de Cuisine Aretah Ettarh, Gramercy Tavern is a distinguished entry on the Forbes All-Star Eateries List. Celebrating 32 years on in the heart of Manhattan’s Flatiron District, this iconic Union Square Hospitality Group institution from restaurateur Danny Meyer has continually reinvented American fine dining. Rather than relying on traditional rigid formality, Gramercy Tavern operates as a "restaurant for every season," anchoring each dining experience in warmth, genuine connectivity, and an unmistakable sense of belonging.

At the center of the restaurant’s endurance is Meyer’s foundational philosophy of Enlightened Hospitality: taking care of the team first.
